1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Ne2 dxe4 5.a.strategy: Regains the pawn at once, putting a knight on a strong central square. Material is level and White is a little ahead in development, so the gambit has bought time at no cost, though Black's position is sound and safe.

Develops with a threat: the knight attacks the one on e4, which no piece defends, so White has to deal with it at once. Black gets a normal French set-up, with the bishop on e7 ready for castling and a comfortable game.
